Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The corner-check error now adds a visible toolpath note. The log line stays. The new test checks the error note and the successful check. The decision file records the choice and the unchanged noise threshold.

I checked the change against upstream main's current `AGENTS.md`. I trial-merged the PR locally with upstream main `4dddc38725387d0e3a3c67e87a7a6938329f5c89`. The merge was clean. No GitHub runner was used.

Local results:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed all 16 steps, including the selected test build. Total: 475 passed, 0 failed, 1 ignored.
- The new pin `operation::keep_law::tests::a_corner_check_that_cannot_run_says_so_in_a_note` passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Safety scope: the change adds a diagnostic note only. It does not change posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, or gouge or collision checks. No goldens changed. Safety-tier mutation runs do not apply. I did not repeat the author's mutation.

No UI files changed. Screenshots do not apply. No dependency or process files changed.

Requested changes: none.

Not exercised: the error through commands or MCP, and the visible note in the GUI. The test calls the private helper with an out-of-range tool diameter. The measured review of the 0.03 mm threshold remains separate work, as the body states.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Merge class: SAME. The head `58d0c41fbb402ba55fb72adb6b93c3a2f8e2f0c6` is the reviewed head, and no commit came after the review. The PR merges cleanly with `main` without a refresh.

This merge relies on the collaborator review of this head by mkinney (`pr-reviewer` marker) and on the `merge-ready` label that he set. The PR fixes a P3 issue, so it needs no second review.
